def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [[1] * w for _ in range(h)]
    twos = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 2]
    sevens = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 7]

    # A 2 on a boundary defines a ray running inward along its row or column.
    v_axes = [(c, r == 0) for r, c in twos if r in (0, h - 1)]
    h_axes = [(r, c == 0) for r, c in twos if c in (0, w - 1)]
    on_axis = set()

    for c, from_top in v_axes:
        pts = [(r, cc) for r, cc in sevens if cc == c]
        if pts:
            on_axis.update(pts)
            edge = 0 if from_top else h - 1
            far = max(r for r, _ in pts) if from_top else min(r for r, _ in pts)
            for r in range(min(edge, far), max(edge, far) + 1):
                out[r][c] = 2

    for r, from_left in h_axes:
        pts = [(rr, c) for rr, c in sevens if rr == r]
        if pts:
            on_axis.update(pts)
            edge = 0 if from_left else w - 1
            far = max(c for _, c in pts) if from_left else min(c for _, c in pts)
            for c in range(min(edge, far), max(edge, far) + 1):
                out[r][c] = 2

    for r, c in on_axis:
        out[r][c] = 7
    for r, c in twos:
        out[r][c] = 2

    off_axis = [(r, c) for r, c in sevens if (r, c) not in on_axis]

    if v_axes and h_axes:
        vc, _ = v_axes[0]
        hr, _ = h_axes[0]
        groups = [
            (r < hr, c < vc, [(r, c) for r, c in off_axis if r < hr and c < vc]),
            (r < hr, c > vc, [(r, c) for r, c in off_axis if r < hr and c > vc]),
            (r > hr, c < vc, [(r, c) for r, c in off_axis if r > hr and c < vc]),
            (r > hr, c > vc, [(r, c) for r, c in off_axis if r > hr and c > vc]),
        ]
        for top, left, pts in groups:
            if not pts:
                continue
            rs = [r for r, c in pts]
            cs = [c for r, c in pts]
            dr = -min(rs) if top else h - 1 - max(rs)
            dc = -min(cs) if left else w - 1 - max(cs)
            for r, c in pts:
                out[r + dr][c + dc] = 7

    elif v_axes:
        vc, from_top = v_axes[0]
        for left in (True, False):
            pts = [(r, c) for r, c in off_axis if (c < vc) == left]
            if not pts:
                continue
            rs = [r for r, c in pts]
            cs = [c for r, c in pts]
            dr = -min(rs) if from_top else h - 1 - max(rs)
            dc = -min(cs) if left else w - 1 - max(cs)
            for r, c in pts:
                out[r + dr][c + dc] = 7

    elif h_axes:
        hr, from_left = h_axes[0]
        for top in (True, False):
            pts = [(r, c) for r, c in off_axis if (r < hr) == top]
            if not pts:
                continue
            rs = [r for r, c in pts]
            cs = [c for r, c in pts]
            dr = -min(rs) if top else h - 1 - max(rs)
            dc = -min(cs) if from_left else w - 1 - max(cs)
            for r, c in pts:
                out[r + dr][c + dc] = 7

    return out
